title: Operations Manager
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26122957  

**Job Category**Rooms \& Guest Services Operations  

**Location**VIP Road opposite Kochi International Airport, Nedumbassery Vappalassery, Kochi Keral 683572, India  

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



Responsible for assisting in successfully executing all operations in the hotel Operations departments (may include Front Office, Business Center, Recreation/Health Club, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Engineering/Maintenance) and managing staff. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department. Ensures that standards and procedures are being followed. Leads specific team while assisting with meeting or exceeding property goals.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Leading Operations Team**


* Ensures that goals are being translated to the team as they relate to guest tracking and productivity.


* Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.


* Understands employee and guest satisfaction results and developing game plans to attack need areas and expand on the strengths.


* Ensures that the team has the capabilities to meet expectations.


* Leads by example demonstrating self\-confidence, energy and enthusiasm.


* Assists employees in understanding guests’ ever\-changing needs and expectations, and exceeding them.

  



**Managing Property Operations Function(s)**


* Follows property specific second effort and recovery plan.


* Publishes all guest satisfaction results in a timely fashion including all guest satisfaction forms, comment cards and guest letters.


* Takes proactive approaches when dealing with employee concerns.


* Extends professionalism and courtesy to employees at all times.


* Communicates/updates all goals and results with employees.


* Meets semiannually with staff on a one\-to\-one basis.


* Assists/teaches the team scheduling against guest and hours/occupied room goals.


* Performs hourly job functions as needed.

  



**Managing and Monitoring Activities that Affect the Guest Experience**


* Provides excellent customer service by being readily available/approachable for all guests.


* Takes proactive approaches when dealing with guest concerns.


* Extends professionalism and courtesy to guests at all times.


* Responds timely to customer service department request.


* Ensures all team members meet or exceed all hospitality requirements.

  



**Managing Profitability**


* Assists in performing required annual Quality audit with GM \& RD.


* Ensures a viable key control program is in place.


* Reviews financial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.

  



**Conducting Human Resources Activities**


* Interviews and assists in making hiring decisions.


* Receives hiring recommendations from team supervisors.


* Ensures orientations for new team members are thorough and completed in a timely fashion.
  

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non\-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*


Tribute Portfolio is a family of independent hotels drawn together by a sense of character and passion for captivating design, vibrant social scenes, and experiences that feel like the real deal. Tribute Portfolio hotels are emboldened to stay true to their own character — they each tell their own design story, connect with their surrounding communities and proudly show off their individual brand identity. In joining Tribute Portfolio, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Job Title: Operations Manager – Jewellery**

**Company:** Muzris Gold and Diamonds  
**Job Location:** Kadavanthra, Kochi  
**Experience:** Minimum 5\+ years in Jewellery Operations  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹45,000 per month

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Operations Manager** with strong experience in jewellery operations. The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day operations, ensuring smooth business processes, supporting sales teams, and maintaining operational standards across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and monitor day\-to\-day jewellery store operations.
* Ensure smooth coordination between sales, accounts, inventory, and management teams.
* Monitor inventory movement, stock handling, and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper billing, documentation, and operational procedures.
* Monitor sales performance and support teams in achieving business targets.
* Handle customer\-related operational issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and security procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams for procurement, stock transfers, and other operational requirements.
* Prepare and review operational reports and provide regular updates to management.
* Identify operational issues and implement effective solutions to improve efficiency.
* Train, guide, and monitor staff to ensure high operational standards.
* Maintain proper records and ensure accuracy in all operational activities.

Requirements

* Minimum **5\+ years of experience in jewellery operations**.
* Strong knowledge of jewellery retail operations and inventory management.
* Experience in handling teams and coordinating multiple departments.
* Good communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong organisational and analytical abilities.
* Knowledge of billing, stock management, and jewellery retail processes will be an advantage.
* Candidates with experience in **gold and diamond jewellery operations** are preferred.

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: E-commerce Operations Manager
description:
ob Title: E\-commerce Operations Manager

**Company:** Angroos  
**Location:** Kadavanthra, Kochi  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, on\-site

Job Description

Angroos is looking for a tech\-savvy, organised E\-commerce Operations Manager to manage daily online store operations—from product listings and order processing to shipment coordination and dispatch. The ideal candidate should be comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, product content, and e\-commerce workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of our e\-commerce website and online marketplaces.
* Create and update product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, prices, categories, and product variations.
* Process orders, verify customer and delivery details, and maintain accurate order records.
* Coordinate packing, shipping, courier pickups, and timely dispatch.
* Track shipments and resolve delivery delays, returns, cancellations, and order\-related issues.
* Maintain inventory accuracy and coordinate stock availability with internal teams.
* Manage store settings, shipping options, offers, and other operational configurations.
* Improve product and category SEO through relevant keywords, clear descriptions, metadata, and image alt text.
* Use AI tools to assist with product content, keyword research, customer\-response drafts, and routine tasks, checking outputs for accuracy.
* Respond to customer enquiries and provide timely order updates.
* Monitor store performance and identify ways to improve the shopping experience and operational efficiency.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Practical knowledge of e\-commerce platforms, online store administration, and order management.
* Familiarity with product listings, inventory, shipping, and dispatch processes.
* Basic understanding of SEO and AI\-powered tools.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, email, and digital business tools.
* Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving ability, and time management.
* Positive attitude, professional behaviour, accountability, and willingness to learn.
* Relevant experience in e\-commerce operations or online store management is preferred.

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed or send your updated CV to **jobnow@angroos.com** with the subject **“E\-commerce Operations Manager – Angroos**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
